title: dawnlog — morning triage receipts for overnight AI agent runs
oneLiner: For developers who let Claude Code run unattended, it reads the session logs already on disk plus git branches and prints a per-branch receipt of what the agent decided, retried, skipped and verified, ranked for merge/fix/kill.
overlaps: AI-Took-My-Job (feedback loop for agents to code repos) and the passed pr-receipt idea (cost per PR) — dawnlog is retroactive behavior triage, not cost or feedback loops; external: Entire CLI and Semantica (hook-based provenance)
